subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Wicked
solution:
The correct answer is: **Admirable**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Wicked **means evil or morally wrong. (बुरा या नैतिक रूप से गलत)

 
 
• **For example- ***She flew at me, shouting how wicked and evil I was.** ***
 
 
 
• Marked option **Admirable **means deserving of admiration or respect. (प्रशंसा या सम्मान का पात्र)
 
 
• **For example- ***She was praised for her admirable conduct on the matter*.
 
 
 
• Therefore, it is clear that 'Admirable' is the **antonym **of 'Wicked' in this context.

Hence, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarcastic **means using irony in a mocking or contemptuous way. (व्यंग्य का उपहास या तिरस्कारपूर्ण तरीके से उपयोग करना)
 
• **Infernal **means relating to hell or the underworld. (नरक या पाताल से संबंधित)
 
• **Dissent **means to hold or express opinions that are at variance with those previously, commonly, or officially expressed. (ऐसी राय रखना या व्यक्त करना जो पहले, आमतौर पर या आधिकारिक तौर पर व्यक्त की गई राय से भिन्न हो)
